kitchenTimeline.title: Order timeline
kitchenTimeline.errorBody: Check the connection and try again.
kitchenTimeline.empty: Nothing has been recorded for this order yet.
kitchenTimeline.stale: Could not refresh. Showing the last loaded steps.

checkout.changeConfirmBody: This cancels the pending UPI request for {{amount}}. Only continue if the guest has not already paid by UPI.
checkout.switchedNotice: UPI request cancelled. Choose how the guest will pay.
checkout.switchedKeptNotice: UPI request cancelled. The reference you typed is kept in case you return to UPI.
checkout.resumedNotice: A UPI payment of {{amount}} was already started for this bill. Enter the reference to confirm it, or change the method.
checkout.recordedNotice: A UPI payment of {{amount}} is already recorded for this bill. Showing it instead of creating another one.
checkout.alreadyPaidBody: This bill was already paid ({{method}}). Nothing more to collect, and nothing was charged twice.
checkout.uncertainTitle: Not sure the last attempt was recorded
checkout.uncertainBody: The connection dropped before we got an answer. Trying again is safe: the same attempt cannot be charged twice. You can also check the status first.
checkout.nothingRecorded: Nothing was recorded for this bill. You can try again or pick another method.
checkout.checkFailed: Could not check the status right now. Try again in a moment.
checkout.cancelRaced: The payment went through before it could be cancelled. It is recorded as paid.
checkout.cancelUnknown: Could not confirm that the UPI request was cancelled. Check the payment status before choosing another method.
checkout.utrKept: Reference {{utr}} from the earlier attempt is kept. Check it matches before you confirm.

billShow.title: Bill - table {{code}}
billShow.errorBody: Check the connection and try again.
billShow.staleError: Could not refresh. This is the last loaded bill.
billShow.noBillBody: The cashier generates the bill first. Ask them to prepare it, then open this screen again.
billShow.notFinalisedTitle: The bill is not ready yet
billShow.notFinalisedBody: The cashier is still preparing it. It can change until it is finalised, so it is not shown to the guest yet.
billShow.paymentPending: A UPI payment is being confirmed by the cashier.

upiSetup.label: Restaurant UPI ID
upiSetup.hint: For example name@bank. Guests pay to this ID.
upiSetup.invalid: Enter a valid UPI ID such as name@bank.
upiSetup.noAccess: Your role cannot change this setting. Ask the owner.
upiSetup.failed: Could not save the UPI ID. Try again.

qr.errorTitle: Could not load the payment QR
qr.errorBody: Check the connection and try again.
qr.receivedBody: Thank you. The bill is settled.

reasons.NOT_FINALISED: The bill is not final yet. Ask the cashier to finalise it.
reasons.VOID: This bill was voided, so there is nothing to pay.
reasons.UPI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The restaurant's UPI ID is not set up yet, so a payment QR cannot be shown.
reasons.UPI_INVALID: The saved UPI ID is not valid, so a payment QR cannot be shown.

qr.askManager: Ask the owner or a manager to add the UPI ID in Configuration, under Checkout.
qr.scanHint: Scan with any UPI app. The amount is filled in for you.
qr.openApp: Pay with a UPI app on this phone
qr.pendingConfirm: Payment started. Waiting for the cashier to confirm it.
qr.staleError: Could not refresh the payment status. Showing the last known state.
qr.markCollectedHint: Opens checkout with UPI selected. Enter the guest's UTR to record the payment.
qr.cashierConfirms: The cashier confirms the payment once it arrives. This screen updates by itself.

checkout_upi_vpa.title: Restaurant UPI ID
checkout_upi_vpa.hint: Guests pay to this UPI ID when staff show the payment QR, for example name@bank.

checkout_upi_payee_name.title: Name shown in the UPI app
checkout_upi_payee_name.hint: Leave empty to use the restaurant name.
